questions.prompt: Evaluate the claim: “Paying only the minimum on a credit card is an efficient repayment strategy.”

options.text: Sometimes true — it depends on the situation

solutionSteps: Never true for saving money. Minimum payments are designed to keep the account current, not to repay quickly. A $3,000 balance at 24.99% with minimum payments (interest + 1%) takes well over a decade and costs thousands in interest.
